main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: From Material Prison to the Pleroma of Light
header_desc: This work integrates first-century spiritual wisdom with twenty-first-century science to answer the fundamental question about our place in the universe. Through the premise that the ego curves space-time, matter emerges from the psyche, and the timeless plane of the cosmos is linked to the pneuma, we are revealed that within us dwells the divine ❤️ spark ✝️.
left_body: The solution to one of the great pillars of modern physics—quantum gravity—finds its key in texts written nearly two thousand years ago: the Gnostic gospels. In this plane, consciousness manifests through the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, revealing that we possess a true free will of perception, mathematically formalized through the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. Space-time tells matter how to move and matter tells space-time how to curve; thus, possessed by the mass and density of an ego that deforms us, shedding it equates to freeing ourselves from that earthly gravity to return to the pure light of the Ineffable Father: The One.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is not much point in praying to the law of gravity.
universe_light_text: The Father and I, we are one: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The division of consciousness between the timeless light of divine feeling and the temporal density of material thought.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: Breaking the chains of illusion is the first step to remembering where we come from. I invite you to invert the map to see the world with different eyes.
